system.description:
This improved version of the Aiming Accuracy Feat moves your enemy -1 step on the Condition Track.

Prerequisite: Droid, Aiming Accuracy, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot

Effect: When using the Aiming Accuracy Feat, a target you damage cannot take the Recover Action until the end of its next turn.
